questions.question: How did Rika become a special grade vengeful cursed spirit?
questions.subject: Rika Orimoto/Synopsis

answer.item: Witnessing her death, Yuta accidentally cursed her while begging her not to die, transforming her into a special grade vengeful cursed spirit.
Unfortunately, she was killed in a car accident that crushed her head.

questions.question: How did Rika defeat Geto's final attack?
questions.subject: Rika Orimoto/Synopsis

answer.item: This vow of sacrifice removed the limits of Rika's cursed energy as she fired a blast of pure love at Geto, overwhelming his attack and severely injuring him.
Rika's curse has been dispelled since it was actually Yuta who cursed her.

questions.question: When did Rika's spirit appear before Marulu Val Vol Yelvori?
questions.subject: Rika Orimoto/Synopsis

answer.item: Rika's spirit would appear before Marulu Val Vol Yelvori after the Simurian had defeated Tsurugi Okkotsu in combat.
